Small sandy beach at base of columns. Wide establishing shot, photorealistic, alien landscape, oppressive atmosphere. No modern elements.

Semi-open, emitting dim blue-green light from within. Wet rocks, seaweed, evening darkness closing in. Wide shot, photorealistic, 17th century, no modern elements.

Torchlight flickering, shadows dancing. Claustrophobic, narrowing toward end. Medium establishing shot, photorealistic, no modern elements.

Organic, pulsating like a heart. Photorealistic product shot, dark background with faint ambient light.

assets.name: 小艇
assets.prompt: A small wooden rowboat, roughly 4m long, weathered wood, oars inside. Partially submerged in water. Photorealistic product shot, soft studio lighting, clean neutral background.

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of the ship log book, last page. Handwritten ink fades at the end. The words 'It saw me' in Portuguese script. A drop of water falls on the page, blurring ink.
shots.lighting: Dim candlelight, warm 2700K, flickering shadows
shots.audio: Faint creak of ship timbers, dripping water

shots.visual: Wide shot of the ship deck at night. Starry sky, no moon. Captain João stands at the bow, telescope raised. Three sailors work ropes in background. Ship rolls gently.
shots.lighting: Only starlight and a dim lantern on mast, cool moonlight

shots.visual: João's weathered face, eyes fixed forward through telescope. His expression shifts from curiosity to unease. The telescope lowers slightly.
shots.lighting: Side light from lantern on left, half face in shadow

shots.camera: tilt up from deck to horizon
shots.visual: The horizon reveals a dark irregular shape—a black island, five-pointed, rising from sea where no land should be. Basalt columns jagged against sky.
shots.lighting: Pre-dawn grey light, low contrast

shots.visual: Small rowboat approaches the black basalt columns. João stands at bow, hand on sword. Sebastião rows, glancing up at towering rock face. Waves lap against columns.
shots.lighting: Overcast daylight, flat, cool 5600K
shots.dialogue: Sebastião: 'Captain, this place is cursed. Turn back.' João: 'We need water.'

shots.visual: Close-up on the basalt column surface—covered in strange glowing symbols, pale blue-green. Symbols pulse faintly as if alive. João's hand touches one, then flinches back.
shots.lighting: Symbols self-illuminated, dim ambient

shots.visual: Boat beaches on narrow sand. Sailors jump out, tie ropes. João steps onto shore, looks around. He pulls out his pistol and walks toward the rock face.
shots.lighting: Overcast, no direct shadows, oppressive
shots.audio: Grit under boots, dripping from oars

shots.visual: The island looms above them. Massive hexagonal basalt columns stretch into low clouds. Symbols glimmer faintly on every surface. The men look tiny against the vast alien architecture.
shots.lighting: Diffuse grey light, no shadows
shots.audio: Wind howls through columns, a single bird far away

shots.visual: Friar Antonio kneeling on wet sand, beads clutched in trembling hands. His eyes are closed, lips moving in prayer. Suddenly he stops, head tilts as if listening to something underground.
shots.lighting: Cool top light from overcast sky, low contrast

shots.camera: slow push in to open book
shots.visual: Antonio's hands flipping pages of an ancient book. He stops at a page with a drawing: a giant eye with tentacles radiating from pupil. Symbols match those on the rocks.
shots.lighting: Book illuminated by dim sky, faint phosphorescent glow from symbols on page

shots.visual: João and Sebastião come up behind Antonio. João looks at the book, then up at the symbols on the cliff. His face hardens.
shots.lighting: Single direction from sea, faces half-lit
shots.dialogue: João: 'What is that symbol?' Antonio: 'The Eye of the Abyss. An old god, erased by the Church.'

shots.camera: tilt up from book to cliff
shots.visual: The camera rises from the open book to the towering rock face covered in glowing Eye symbols. The symbols are now pulsing more rapidly, synchronized with a low throbbing sound.
shots.lighting: Symbols brighten, casting eerie blue-green light on the scene

shots.visual: Evening. Tides recede revealing the base of the cliff. A stone door emerges from foam—black stone carved with the Eye symbol. Partially open, blue-green light leaks from the gap.
shots.lighting: Twilight, fading natural light, interior glow warm 2700K mixed with eerie cool

shots.visual: João approaches the door, lantern held high. He studies the carving: a giant eye with a vortex of tentacles in the pupil. His reflection in the wet stone seems to move independently.
shots.lighting: Lantern light on face, side warm key, cool rim from interior

shots.visual: Sebastião and Antonio behind him. Sebastião draws his sword, Antonio crosses himself. João pushes the door wider; the light intensifies. A sulfurous breeze hits them.
shots.lighting: Doorway light casts long shadows toward camera
shots.dialogue: Sebastião: 'Captain, no.' João: 'I will see what is inside.'

shots.visual: João steps through the doorway into the tunnel, lantern raised. The camera follows, revealing organic walls glowing faintly. The door behind him starts to close slowly—unseen hands?
shots.lighting: Ambient organic glow + lantern, warm and cold mixed
shots.audio: Stone scraping behind, wet squelching ahead

shots.visual: Close-up of the tunnel wall—pulsing, fleshy substance like skin woven with mycelium. It contracts as if breathing. João's hand passes close; it recoils slightly.
shots.lighting: Bioluminescent blue-green glow from wall, dim

shots.visual: João, Sebastião, Antonio and two sailors move cautiously. Their lanterns flicker. One by one, lanterns die—first one sailor's, then another's. Darkness closes in.
shots.lighting: Losing light, becoming almost total darkness except wall glow
shots.dialogue: Sailor: 'My lantern—it's gone out!' Another: 'Mine too!'
shots.audio: Panic breaths, footsteps on organic matter

shots.visual: In near darkness, only wall glow reveals João's face. His pupils are dilated, reflecting faint blue-green. He whispers something, lips moving.
shots.lighting: Extreme low light, wall glow on face only
shots.audio: Distant low hum, as if responding

shots.visual: The tunnel opens into a vast space. In the distance, a faint glow reveals a floating sphere. Tentacles hang from ceiling. The scale is immense.
shots.lighting: Soft cool light from sphere, illuminating space

shots.visual: The full underground dome revealed. Central sphere, 3m diameter, surface churning with dark purple veins, floating mid-air. Hundreds of tentacles hang from ceiling, tips glowing blue-green. Walls covered in glowing symbols.
shots.lighting: Sphere self-light, cool 5000K, creating deep shadows
shots.audio: Low thrumming, like a giant engine

shots.visual: Antonio steps forward, book in hand. He compares the symbols on the wall to the book—they match exactly. His face shows terror and awe. A tentacle near him twitches.
shots.lighting: Glow from symbols and sphere, mixed on face
shots.dialogue: Antonio: 'The Abyssal Eye... we must not be here.'

shots.visual: João draws his pistol and aims at the sphere. Sebastião grabs his arm. The sphere's purple veins pulse faster, reacting to their presence.
shots.lighting: Sphere light creates backlight on men, faces dark
shots.dialogue: Sebastião: 'Don't provoke it!' João: 'We must destroy it.'

shots.visual: The sphere's surface suddenly smooths. Across it, a face forms—the face of Pedro, but distorted, eyes black holes. The mouth opens wide, emitting a silent scream. The tentacles around the sphere begin to move with purpose.
shots.lighting: Face on sphere self-luminous, cold blue-white

shots.visual: A tentacle shoots from the sphere toward sailor Pedro. It pierces his chest without blood. Pedro's body contorts, bones cracking audibly. His skin writhes as something moves underneath.
shots.lighting: Sphere light harsh on scene, shadows sharp

shots.visual: Pedro's face—eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, but instead of a scream, a low vibrating hum identical to the underground murmur emanates from his throat. His pupils roll back, then snap forward—now black, no iris.
shots.lighting: Symbols on wall casting blue-green on his skin

shots.visual: João fires his pistol at the sphere. The bullet hits the surface and vanishes absorbed without effect. The tentacles retract, then more shoot out toward two other sailors. They are wrapped and lifted, bodies dissolving into blue-green particles absorbed by the sphere.
shots.lighting: Muzzle flash illuminates cave briefly, then return to eerie glow
shots.audio: Gunshot echoes, wet absorption, sailor screams cut short

shots.visual: The sphere pulses faster, whole dome vibrating. More tentacles descend, whipping. Sailors run toward exit. Sebastião grabs João's arm, pulls him back. The sphere surface now shows Pedro's face again, mouthing silently.
shots.lighting: Strobe-like pulsing from sphere, disorienting

shots.visual: João takes one last look at the sphere—it forms Pedro's face, then shifts to his own face, distorted. His eyes widen in horror. He turns and runs toward the tunnel.
shots.lighting: Sphere light fades as he turns, shadow consuming his face
shots.audio: His own panicked breath, cave roar

shots.visual: Survivors burst out of the stone door into the night. They stumble onto wet sand, gasping. João looks back—the door is slowly closing, as if by itself. The Eye symbol on it glows faintly.
shots.lighting: Night, starlight, weak, door glow faint blue-green

shots.camera: tilt up from ground to door
shots.visual: The stone door fully closes, merging seamlessly with the cliff. No trace remains except a slight vibration in the rock. The Eye symbol fades. The survivors stand in darkness, terrified.
shots.lighting: Only starlight, very dim
shots.dialogue: Antonio: 'We must leave this island. Now.'

shots.visual: The group rushes to the rowboat, shoving off into the water. João, Sebastião, Antonio and two remaining sailors row frantically. The island behind them looms silent.
shots.lighting: Moon breaks through clouds, silver light on sea

shots.visual: As they row away, the camera watches the black island recede. Suddenly, a massive shape moves beneath the water—a huge dark bulk passes under the boat, setting it rocking violently. Whatever it is, it's beyond the island itself.
shots.lighting: Moonlight glints on moving water, dark shape

shots.visual: They climb aboard the Santa Catarina. The deck is covered in creeping organic substance—mycelium-like filaments crawling up masts and sails. The ship is being consumed.
shots.lighting: Dawn light, grey, sickly
shots.audio: Crackling of organic growth, wood groaning

shots.visual: Close-up of the organic matter on the ship's rail—it pulses with the same rhythm as the sphere. João draws his pistol, but then stops, realizing firearms are useless. He stares at the growing infection.
shots.lighting: Dawn light, low contrast
shots.dialogue: João: 'There's only one way to stop it.'
shots.audio: Pulse of the growth, slow wet sounds

shots.camera: handheld, Sebastian and Joao face off
shots.visual: João tells Sebastião to take survivors in the longboat. He will stay and ignite the powder magazine. Sebastião protests, but João is resolute.
shots.lighting: Horizon brightening, faces in shadow against dark ship
shots.dialogue: João: 'I will light the powder. Go.' Sebastião: 'You'll die!' João: 'Perhaps. Go.'
shots.audio: Crying gulls, organic crackling in background

shots.visual: The longboat lowers into the water with Sebastião, Antonio and two others. João stands alone on the deck, torch in hand. He watches them row away, then walks toward the cargo hatch. The organic matter crawls toward him.
shots.lighting: Rising sun silhouettes ship, orange glow
shots.audio: Rope creaking, waves, distant explosion anticipation

shots.visual: The Santa Catarina explodes in a massive fireball. Debris flies into the dawn sky. The shockwave reaches the longboat, rocking it violently. Sebastião shields his eyes.
shots.lighting: Fireball orange-white, overexposed, then smoke

shots.visual: As the smoke clears, Sebastião looks back. Through the haze, a massive shape rises from the sea—much larger than the island—a bulbous black mass with tentacles reaching for the sky, blocking the sun. The 'island' was just its back.
shots.lighting: Shape eclipses sun, silhouette against bright sky
shots.dialogue: Antonio: 'It is not an island... it is a creature.'
shots.audio: Deep rumbling, water cascading off the rising mass

shots.visual: The longboat drifts. Floating on the water is João's hat. As it turns, João's face appears beneath the water, eyes now glowing with the Eye symbol—pupil replaced by tentacle vortex. He smiles an inhuman smile, then sinks.
shots.lighting: Underwater green-blue glow, surface ripples
shots.audio: Low chanting whisper: 'You will return too.'

shots.visual: The logbook lies open in the bottom of the longboat. The last page now has fresh ink writing: 'You will return too.' The ink spreads, forming the Eye symbol. The camera stays on the page as the whispering fades.
shots.lighting: Daylight, soft, on page
shots.audio: Whispering fades to silence, then distant seabird
